energy_denominator: total energy on all 384 measured channels before translation
whitening_interpretation: intentional measurement/injection domain because the compact handoff has no full-probe residual whitening model; not evidence of equivalence to the accepted spatially whitened template bank
future_injection_requirement: inject the measured no-spatial-whitening templates exactly once into the same post-ibllikecmr standardized float32 domain before matching; every arm consumes the identical injected source
double_processing_forbidden: the experiment-local source must bypass any second ibllikecmr standardization or spatial whitening before arm branching; validate waveform units and byte-identical shared source identity before eventual GPU launch

ap191.status: detected bad but retained as an actual measured trace
ap191.processing: high-pass and phase shift; both common references use the 383 detected-good channels; scale uses AP191's measured noise after the first reference
ap191.ordinary_path_comparison: all 383 good-channel traces must match the ordinary channel-removal path within max absolute 1e-5 on three guarded one-second intervals
ap191.caveat: the ordinary accepted path removes AP191, so AP191 itself has no accepted-path equivalence claim; retaining it only keeps the measured-384 denominator auditable
